title: IT Infrastructure (L2/Subject matter Expert)
jobDescription:
Job Description: IT Infrastructure SME (L2 / Subject Matter Expert) Work/Job Location: Work from Office – Perungudi, Chennai Tamil Nadu | Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required) Candidate Profile: Smart, Energetic, Responsible, should be fluent in English, Presentable, Management Skills, Dedicated, and with a clear employment background. Qualification: Computer Science/Technology Graduates Shift: Rotational Shift Certification : CCNA and networking certifications

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Infrastructure Management Manage Windows and Linux servers, including administration, patching, performance monitoring, and service availability. Manage Active Directory, Group Policies, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and related infrastructure services. Support network troubleshooting and coordinate with ISPs and infrastructure vendors. Security Management Manage endpoint security, antivirus, EDR, DLP, MDM, email security, and security monitoring solutions. Review security alerts, investigate incidents, and coordinate remediation activities. Implement security hardening, vulnerability management, and patch compliance programs. Compliance & Governance Implement and maintain Information Security Management System (ISMS) controls aligned with ISO 27001:2022 and HIPAA Security Rule requirements. Develop and maintain IT security policies, standards, SOPs, and operational procedures. Support risk assessments, compliance reviews, audits, and corrective action tracking. Manage IT-related compliance awareness programs and phishing simulations. Backup, BCP & DR Manage backup operations, recovery testing, and restoration activities. Develop, maintain, and periodically test Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery procedures. Ensure backup compliance and recovery readiness. Incident & Problem Management Handle L2/L3 escalations from Front Desk Engineers. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and critical outages. Lead major incident management and service restoration efforts. Vendor & Project Coordination Coordinate with OEMs, ISPs, software vendors, and third-party service providers. Evaluate and recommend technology improvements, upgrades, and security enhancements. Support implementation of new IT infrastructure and security initiatives. Reporting & Governance Review SLA performance and service metrics. Prepare monthly operational, security, compliance, and management reports. Participate in governance meetings and provide strategic recommendations for IT operations and security improvements.

title: Linux Embedded Computer Vision Developer

title: Cognos Senior Architect
jobDescription: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Cognos Senior Architect to lead the design, deployment, optimization, and modernization of IBM Cognos BI solutions. The role involves defining BI architecture, managing end-to-end deployments, driving platform upgrades, and leading Cognos-to-Power BI migration initiatives. The ideal candidate should have experience supporting Model N Flex applications and developing reporting and analytics solutions for Commercial Contracting and Government Pricing functions within the pharmaceutical industry. Key Responsibilities Define and implement Cognos BI architecture, standards, and best practices. Design and optimize Framework Manager models, Transformer Cubes, reports, dashboards, schedules, bursting, and event-driven reporting. Lead Cognos platform administration, upgrades, security, and performance tuning. Manage end-to-end deployment and release activities across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments. Drive Cognos modernization and Cognos-to-Power BI migration initiatives. Develop and support Model N Flex Reporting & Analytics solutions using IBM Cognos. Design and maintain reports and dashboards for Commercial Contracting, Chargebacks, Rebates, Membership, Sales Analytics, and Government Pricing business processes. Develop reporting solutions for AMP, Best Price, Medicaid, Federal Supply Schedule (FSS), 340B, and other Government Pricing programs . Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions. Provide technical leadership, governance, and mentoring to development teams. Required Skills Strong expertise in IBM Cognos Analytics, Framework Manager, Reporting, Administration, Scheduling, and Bursting. Hands-on experience in Cognos content deployment, migration, release management, and production support . Strong SQL, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Dimensional Modeling skills. Experience in Cognos performance tuning, security, and platform optimization. Hands-on experience with Model N Flex Applications and Cognos-based reporting solutions. Strong understanding of Commercial Contract Management, Chargebacks, Rebates, Membership, Sales Operations, and Government Pricing reporting processes. Experience developing complex reports and analytics for AMP, Best Price, Medicaid, FSS, and other Managed Markets reporting requirements . Exposure to Cognos-to-Power BI migration projects preferred. Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills. Preferred Industry Experience Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences domain experience. Experience supporting Managed Markets, Commercial Operations, and Government Pricing Analytics using Model N Flex and Cognos Reporting. Experience working with cross-functional teams including Government Pricing, Contracting, Revenue Management, and Commercial Analytics stakeholders.

title: Techno Functional Data & Analytics Lead
jobDescription: Job Description – Techno Functional Data & Analytics Lead (Associate Director / Director Level) Position: Leader – Techno Functional Data & Analytics SME (AD/D Level) Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical Industry Experience: 12+ Years Location: Open / Hybrid Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Techno-Functional Data & Analytics Leader to drive enterprise-wide data, analytics, and AI/ML initiatives within the Life Sciences industry. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in pharmaceutical data ecosystems, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and cloud-based data platforms, with strong exposure to Commercial and/or R&D business functions. This role will act as a strategic bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, enabling data-driven decision-making, digital transformation, and innovation across the organization. Key Responsibilities Data & Analytics Leadership Lead the design and implementation of enterprise data and analytics strategies aligned with Life Sciences business objectives. Drive data modernization initiatives, including cloud-based data platforms, data lakes, and advanced analytics solutions. Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for leveraging data, AI, and machine learning to improve business outcomes. Define and govern data standards, quality frameworks, and data management best practices. Life Sciences Domain Expertise Provide techno-functional leadership across Commercial and/or R&D functions within the pharmaceutical domain. Work extensively with pharmaceutical industry datasets, including: Syndicated market data (IQVIA, Symphony Health, etc.) Sales and prescription data Patient and claims data CRM and customer engagement data Clinical trial and R&D data Master and reference data Translate complex business requirements into scalable analytics and reporting solutions. Business Intelligence & Advanced Analytics Lead the development of business intelligence, dashboarding, and self-service analytics solutions. Enable insights generation through descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics. Drive KPI definition, reporting standardization, and executive-level performance monitoring. Collaborate with data scientists and business teams to operationalize advanced analytics use cases. Cloud & AI/ML Enablement Architect and implement cloud-based analytics solutions using platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Drive adoption of AI/ML technologies for forecasting, customer segmentation, next-best-action recommendations, commercial effectiveness, and clinical analytics. Oversee the deployment and governance of machine learning models in production environments. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions for business growth.

title: Senior Power BI Developer
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, Paginated reports, and dashboards based on business requirements.
- Gather, analyze, and translate business needs into technical specifications and data models.
- Build efficient data models in Power BI (star/snowflake schemas, relationships, calculated columns, and measures using DAX).
- Use Power Query to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources (SQL databases, Excel, cloud sources).
- Optimize report performance (query folding, aggregations, incremental refresh, measures optimization).
- Implement and manage row‑level security (RLS) and follow governance standards for data access and security.
- Ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy through validation, testing, and documentation.
- Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and business users to align BI solutions with business goals.
- Publish and manage content in Power BI Service, including workspaces, apps, dataflows, and refresh schedules.
- Provide user training, support, and best‑practice guidance to self‑service Power BI users.
- Stay current with new Power BI features and recommend improvements to existing BI solutions.
- Create flows/schedules in Power Automate and create interface through Power Apps to publish reports. Required Skills and Qualifications
- Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Hands‑on experience 6+ years building reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
- Strong proficiency in DAX for building calculated measures and advanced calculations.
- Solid experience with Power Query/M and data transformation techniques.
- Good understanding of relational databases, SQL querying, and data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, star schema).
- Experience connecting to and integrating multiple data sources (on‑premises and cloud).
- Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance concepts.
- Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work closely with business stakeholders, gather requirements, and convert them into technical designs.

title: Oracle Database Administrator (Oracle DBA)
jobDescription: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) with 6+ years of hands-on experience in managing, maintaining, and optimizing Oracle database environments. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Oracle Database administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability solutions, and production support. The candidate should be capable of handling critical database operations in a 24x7 enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, upgrade, and patch Oracle Database (11g, 12c, 19c, and above). Perform database administration activities including creation, migration, cloning, and decommissioning of databases. Monitor database health, performance, storage, and availability. Perform database performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Trace, and execution plans. Manage backup and recovery using RMAN and perform disaster recovery activities. Administer Oracle Data Guard for high availability and disaster recovery. Manage Oracle RAC environments and troubleshoot cluster-related issues. Perform database security administration, including user management, roles, privileges, and auditing. Implement database patching, PSU/RU updates, and Oracle upgrades. Troubleshoot database performance issues, locking, blocking, deadlocks, and space management problems. Automate routine DBA tasks using Shell scripting or PL/SQL. Monitor database alerts, logs, and proactively resolve issues. Coordinate with application, infrastructure, and development teams during deployments and production releases. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks. Participate in on-call support and production incident management. Required Skills 6+ years of Oracle Database Administration experience. Strong knowledge of Oracle Database 11g, 12c, and 19c. Expertise in RMAN Backup and Recovery. Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC and Oracle Data Guard. Strong SQL and PL/SQL knowledge. Experience in database performance tuning and SQL optimization. Knowledge of Oracle ASM (Automatic Storage Management). Experience with database patching, upgrades, and migrations. Proficiency in Linux/UNIX administration and Shell scripting. Good understanding of Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM). Knowledge of database security and auditing. Experience supporting mission-critical production databases. Preferred Skills Experience with Oracle Golden Gate. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of automation tools such as Ansible. Experience with Dev Ops tools like Git, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with ITIL processes, incident management, and change management. Educational Qualification Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Oracle Database certifications are preferred. Desired Candidate Profile Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced production environment. Flexible to work in rotational shifts and provide on-call support when required. Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

title: Senior Network Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description – Senior Network Engineer Experience 8+ Years in enterprise network operations and engineering environments Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking, AWS cloud networking, Palo Alto firewalls, Aruba wireless, and ZTNA solutions such as Zscaler. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day network operations, troubleshooting, cloud connectivity, and security support across on-prem and cloud environments. Roles & Responsibilities Responsible for day-to-day network operations including monitoring, incident resolution, and service request handling. Configure, operate, and support Cisco and Juniper switches for LAN and WAN connectivity. Manage and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls including security policies, NAT, and VPN operations. Support and maintain Aruba wireless infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance. Perform routing and switching activities such as VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, and basic routing troubleshooting. Assist with AWS cloud networking operations including: VPCs Subnets Route Tables NACLs Security Groups Transit Gateway (TGW) Private Link Support site-to-site and remote-access VPN connectivity across on-prem and cloud environments. Support and troubleshoot ZTNA/SASE solutions, preferably Zscaler ZIA and ZPA. Support internal teams and customers in resolving network connectivity and troubleshooting issues. Participate in change management, maintenance activities, and configuration deployments following ITSM processes. Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures. Work with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams for issue resolution and project implementation. Required Skills Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Cisco and Juniper switches. Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, NAT, and IPSec VPNs. Experience with Aruba wireless access points. Good understanding of AWS networking concepts. Experience with Zscaler Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions. Familiarity with ITSM processes and enterprise support environments. Strong troubleshooting and communication skills. Experience with network automation tools or scripting is a plus.
